file_index.schema:
CREATE TABLE file_index (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            path TEXT UNIQUE,
            size INTEGER,
            hash TEXT
        )

github_repos.schema:
CREATE TABLE github_repos (
            name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            visibility TEXT,
            default_branch TEXT,
            has_readme INTEGER,
            has_gitignore INTEGER,
            has_license INTEGER,
            workflow_count INTEGER,
            open_pr_count INTEGER,
            file_tree_json TEXT,
            audit_notes TEXT,
            status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending'
        )

nomic_embeddings.schema:
CREATE TABLE nomic_embeddings (
            repo_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            embedding BLOB,
            text_payload TEXT,
            FOREIGN KEY(repo_name) REFERENCES github_repos(name)
        )
